Narrative function: The event that makes the predicament active
Must deliver: A concrete action by another character, not an internal feeling
Shot spec (vertical): Two-hander per VF-07. Alternating axis-respecting shots

Narrative function: Raise the cost at least once

Shot spec (vertical): Emotional close-up then reaction. Every P0 anchor present
Cut rule: Match cut to the earlier beat being reversed
Common failure: Reveal arrives without setup, so it reads as noise
